_comment: Configurable analysis rules (FR-44). Every rule states its justification and status. 'standard' = taken from a recognised index definition; 'provisional_not_approved' = a provisional relative comparison that the AI/Analysis team must confirm before release. No rule here is a regulatory limit — regulatory limits come only from user-verified planning rules.

climate_indices.label: Summer days (Tmax > 25 °C)
climate_indices.justification: ETCCDI climate index SU (Expert Team on Climate Change Detection and Indices).

climate_indices.label: Very hot days (Tmax ≥ 35 °C)
climate_indices.justification: 35 °C is used by several national meteorological services as a 'very hot day' marker; not an international standard. Confirm for the project region.

climate_indices.label: Extremely hot days (Tmax ≥ 40 °C)
climate_indices.justification: Project default extreme marker; confirm for the project region.

findings.title: Frequent very hot days in the regional climate record
findings.justification: Counts of days with Tmax ≥ 35 °C (see TX35). Severity bands are a provisional project default and must be confirmed.
findings.limitation: Regional reanalysis air temperature (~25 km grid). It describes regional climate exposure, not conditions inside the development.

findings.title: Site surfaces observed warmer than their surroundings
findings.justification: Relative comparison of median land surface temperature inside the site with the surrounding ring (no recognised absolute threshold exists). The 2 K / 4 K bands are provisional and must be confirmed by the AI/Analysis team.
findings.limitation: Landsat LST is the temperature of observed surfaces at ~10:30 local solar time on clear days (thermal band native resolution 100 m). It is not air temperature or pedestrian comfort, and warmer surfaces do not prove that any building causes heating.

findings.title: Concentration of the study area's hottest surfaces within the site
findings.justification: By construction 10% of study-area pixels are in the hottest decile; a site share of ≥ 20% (2× expectation) is flagged as a relative concentration. Provisional project default.
findings.limitation: Relative classification within one study area; not comparable across cities. Based on the cloud-free scenes listed.

findings.title: Limited observed vegetation on the site
findings.justification: Share of site pixels with NDVI ≥ 0.2. NDVI ≈ 0.2 is a widely used remote-sensing convention separating bare/built surfaces from sparse vegetation; the 10%/25% bands are provisional.
findings.limitation: NDVI indicates vegetation-related reflectance at the image dates only. It does not measure canopy health, shade, irrigation or cooling.

findings.title: Large exposed open spaces at mid-afternoon
findings.justification: Share of designated open/green/parking space not in building-cast shade at 15:00 true solar time on the analysis date. Bands are provisional.
findings.limitation: Geometric shade from buildings and shade structures with known heights on flat terrain. Trees are treated as opaque only if canopy size is supplied; off-site obstructions are not modelled.
